items.title: US regulators grant long-awaited Boeing 737 MAX 7 certificate
items.summary: More than eight years after Boeing organized the maiden flight of the 737 MAX 7, the aircraft has won certification, US authorities announced Monday.Monday's announcement marks Boeing's first new aircraft certified since the safety problems that have engulfed the company in recent years.
